(Registered 10 April 2017) 14 - 20 October 2018: I visited Washington DC and New York to talk about my experience as a student of the Washington Ireland Program in 2010 and 2012. Flight costs, accommodation for one night and a train journey was paid by the Washington Ireland Program, an organisation based in Ireland and the United States of America. The total cost covered by the Washington Ireland Program was 1,219-92 USD or 948- 60 GBP. (Registered 25 October 2018) 28 November 2018 - 1 December 2018: I attended the 'Twenty Years of Peace' conference in Connecticut, United States of America, which was organised by Yale University. The cost of flights, transfers, accommodation and meals was covered by Yale University. (Registered 12 December 2018) 27 February 2020: I delivered a guest lecture on 'The Role of Progressives in Northern Ireland Unionism' at Birkbeck College, University of London. interests.canonicalKey: MLA|Northern Ireland|dawn purvis|overseas visits|on 14th 16th february 2008 i attended the international school for peace studies messines belgium to meet and talk to young participants on the school s link programme facilitated by the david ervine foundation the cost was met by fas training and employment authority on 28th october 1st november 2009 i attended and spoke at the graduation of participants of wider horizons programme in pittsburgh p a u s a i also took part in a panel debate in university of pittsburgh the cost was met by the ireland institute of pittsburgh on 27th 28th january 2011 i attended the international converence on enhancing the role of women in reconciliation and accountability in iraq through socio political empowerment in erbil kurdistan iraq the cost was met by the international alliance for justice and no peace without justice in partnership with the foundation for the future and the westminster foundation for democracy registered 21 february 2011 on 14 18 march 2011 i travelled to the united states to meet with members of the us congress and local ggos as part of a family planning association delegation to discuss access to abortion services in northern ireland the cost was met by jrsst charitable trust registered 24 march 2011 dagger
interests.interestText: On 14th - 16th February 2008 I attended the International School for Peace Studies, Messines, Belgium to meet and talk to young participants on the school's Link Programme facilitated by the David Ervine Foundation. The cost was met by FAS - Training and Employment Authority. On 28th October - 1st November 2009 I attended and spoke at the graduation of participants of Wider Horizons programme in Pittsburgh, P.A., U.S.A. I also took part in a panel debate in University of Pittsburgh. The cost was met by the Ireland Institute of Pittsburgh. On 27th - 28th January 2011 I attended the International Converence on 'Enhancing the Role of Women in Reconciliation and Accountability in Iraq through Socio-Political Empowerment' in Erbil, Kurdistan-Iraq. The cost was met by the International Alliance for Justice and No Peace without Justice, in partnership with the Foundation for the Future and the Westminster Foundation for Democracy. (Registered 21 February 2011) On 14 - 18 March 2011 I travelled to the United States to meet with members of the US Congress and local GGOs as part of a Family Planning Association delegation to discuss access to abortion services in Northern Ireland. The cost was met by JRSST Charitable Trust. (Registered 24 March 2011) †
